says: The runbook cites 0532 for the loop's once-only cancel and its rate-limit wait, and tells every agent on the login to stop polling and land nothing until the reset, but neither 0532 nor 0611 holds those rules (0571: a runbook never holds a rule no decision holds).
proof: grep -n -i 'rate limit\|limited\|refus\|4xx' .decisions/0532-a-sev0-freezes-ci.md prints only line 68 about a dequeue; 0611 has no rate-limit line; the runbook's follows list is only 0532 and 0611.
cost: A rule lives only in a runbook and in code comments, which 0571 forbids and the runbook check cannot see.
